method_specification.methodology_stated_.reason: The Introduction describes empirical calibration, AUROC and motif-attribution results before Method. These limitations prevent the strong tier.

The paper interprets them as near-threshold failures with apparently healthy hierarchies.

failure_analysis.uncertainty_failures_ad.reason: Both error directions receive quantitative and chemical characterization: 20.8±0.9% of failures fall in the lower uncertainty half, while 25.3±0.4% of the highest-uncertainty decile have errors below 0.5 kcal/mol. Structural examples and the distinction between decomposition strain and actual prediction error explain both.
